title: Manor Born: big spaces, small community.
videoTitle: PROPERTY REVIEW #159 | RM 2.7 MIL BUNGALOW IN MANOR BORN, IPOH
excerpt: Eighteen strata bungalows placed inside an existing guarded estate, where a central air well solves the problem every very large house has — and the arrival never quite matches the arrival hall.
takeaways: An 18-bungalow strata enclave inside The Dales, behind two guardhouses.
A squarish 70 by 88 ft lot, an air well and windows on every side keep a 7,631 sq ft house bright and practical.
Highway noise outside and thin common areas are the trade-offs.

sections.heading: What sets it apart
paragraphs: Manor Born is a gated strata enclave of just 18 bungalows inside The Dales, one of Ipoh's most exclusive addresses, so residents pass two guardhouses on the way home. The house Sean tours, listed in the episode title at RM2.7 million, sits on a squarish 70 by 88 ft lot with 7,631 sq ft over three floors, eight bedrooms and eight bathrooms.
Windows on all four sides, a central air well and windows in the basement keep even the middle of such a large house bright. Residents share a pool, gym and barbecue area.

sections.heading: Where it is
paragraphs: It is on Jalan Tambun, the road between Tambun and Ipoh town, on the same high-end stretch as The Thompson, The Enclave and Tiger Lane. Limestone hills rise behind the houses; a highway runs in front.

pros: Practical design at every scale: the squarish lot gives every room real width, length and height, and the air well and basement windows solve the dark spots a house this big usually has.
Strata inside an already guarded estate: two guardhouses, a uniform design, a shared pool and gym, and because it is completed, you can see who your neighbours are before you buy.
The setting: Ipoh's top addresses on one street, and a limestone backdrop that Sean says looks like a painting from the staircase window.
cons: Highway noise: fine once the windows are shut, but it intrudes on the balconies and outdoor spaces.
An awkward entrance: the way into The Dales is a narrow road through a small corner under a bridge that feels accidental, though it keeps the address discreet.
Thin common areas: most of the land went to the 18 private plots, so roads, verges and landscaping are minimal and the arrival doesn't match the houses.

closing: For buyers who want a large, practical bungalow in a small, known community, provided the highway in front doesn't bother them.
sourceNote: Based on Sean's full English captions for this May 2021 episode. The 3 on 3 follows the three things he likes and the three he doesn't, in his order, at the end of the video. The developer's team invited Sean to view the project.
